description.value: A Walmart Supercenter (Store 3025) in Duncan, BC, offering a full range of groceries alongside electronics, clothing, furniture, and baby products. As one of the larger retail anchors in the Cowichan Valley, it represents a comprehensive resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through the region. The store is tagged wheelchair accessible in OSM.

Most subpages were blocked by bot-verification walls, so no specific amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, etc.) could be extracted from the website beyond the grocery confirmation.
